facts.text: Scenario-level accident evidence is almost entirely from mining haul trucks and underground machines, leaving limited scenario-level coverage beyond mining.
facts.quote: The scenario-level evidence is almost entirely from mining haul trucks and underground machines.

facts.text: Excavators, telehandlers, compact loaders and articulated dump trucks on construction sites have only aggregate struck-by statistics supporting their accident evidence.
facts.quote: Excavators, telehandlers, compact loaders and articulated dump trucks on construction sites, which the product must also cover, have only aggregate struck-by statistics behind them.

facts.text: The collision mitigation product must also cover excavators, telehandlers, compact loaders and articulated dump trucks on construction sites.
facts.quote: Excavators, telehandlers, compact loaders and articulated dump trucks on construction sites, which the product must also cover

facts.text: None of the accident sources addresses interactions between manned machines equipped with automatic braking and autonomous haulage.
facts.quote: None of the accident sources addresses interactions between manned machines with automatic braking and autonomous haulage

facts.text: NIOSH's virtual-mine work points toward studying interactions between manned machines with automatic braking and autonomous haulage.
facts.quote: although NIOSH's virtual-mine work points that way [87]

facts.text: Cybersecurity, configuration control and software updates become safety-relevant once software can command machine brakes.
facts.quote: *Cybersecurity, configuration control and software updates* become safety-relevant once software can command the brakes.

facts.text: No collision-incident statistics quantify the safety risk from cybersecurity, configuration control and software updates when software can command machine brakes.
facts.quote: No collision-incident statistics quantify this risk

facts.text: Safety risks from cybersecurity, configuration control and software updates in software-controlled braking should be handled through the product's functional-safety and cybersecurity processes rather than assigned an accident frequency without evidence.
facts.quote: it should be handled through the product's functional-safety and cybersecurity processes rather than assigned an accident frequency without evidence.
